final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT AVG(s1.avg_bandusage) AS avg_of_kept_averages, SUM(s1.record_count) AS sum_of_kept_counts, AVG(s1.avg_bandusage - s2.overall_avg) AS avg_difference FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.avg_bandusage > s2.overall_avg
